versions.changelog:
- Initial release of youtube-performance skill.
- Track YouTube channel analytics including views, watch time, subscriber growth, and engagement metrics.
- Supports real-time and historical performance data via Boring integration.
- Requires an MCP Connector link for secure, read-only analytics access.
- No local API keys needed; all authentication is handled via the embedded MCP link.
- Comprehensive instructions and error handling guidance included.
